text.description_html:
Hamilton DEP-205-BP, 4 Inch Bronze Edge Door Pull

This Small Edge Pull is cast in solid bronze with high quality craftsmanship. Traditional style made by master craftsman. Hamilton Bronze Patina edge door pull for use on pocket or sliding doors. It is installed into a pocket doors edge and used to pull the door out of the pocket.

Specifications for the Hamilton DEP-205-BP 4 Inch Bronze Edge Door Pull:

  • Finish: Bronze Patina
  • Total Height: 4"
  • Total Width: 3/4"
  • Total Depth: 1-3/4"
  • 1/8" Thick Solid Bronze
  • Packaged with matching finish mounting screws
  • Hamilton DEP-205-BP Dimensions (PDF)

Sold Individually



** This item is discontinued.
